reviews.title: Best Value RGB Case at This Price Point
reviews.comment: For the price, the Raidmax I802 is honestly a steal—especially since it comes with five RGB infinity fans included. The case looks great its really sturdy once built and is easy to cable manage, even for beginners. The side panel comes off easily, but just a heads up: the front panel does take a bit more force to remove. My only gripe is that all the fans are powered by molex and have fixed RGB—there’s no way to control the lighting or fan speed. If Raidmax had made the RGB controllable, this case would be unbeatable for value. Even with this downside, I’d still recommend it for anyone wanting an affordable, stylish “fishtank” case with lots of included fans.
reviews.author: JoelTech

reviews.title: Pretty good case
reviews.comment: There are a few nice things in this case, for example, the lower-mounted fan (to cool a graphics card) and the fact that both glass panels open without screws (which makes working on it pretty awesome). Plenty of space, glass is so clear that it seems it's not there at all, good airflow. Not so great: - The metal is soft (mine arrived a little bumped in the lower part due to transport, and there is no way I can fix that; however, this case is for my kid, and he didn't care at all about that little imperfection. - The fan screws in the bottom screw directly into the metal (which is soft), so there is a risk of stripping it. Not worth removing starts for those, just be careful when using it.
reviews.author: Ottaviani Luigi

reviews.title: Unbeatable cost
reviews.comment: Built my girlfriend’s first pc for Christmas. For the cost it’s easily recommended. Very easy to build in and the included fans are already daisy chained. Knocked 1 star off due to also ordering a White cpu cooler that they sell but they sent a black one instead. Not a huge biggie and I still used it. P.s if anyone is confused where the 4 pin connector is to power the fans, it uses SATA cable so make sure you plug a sata cable into Your power supply before installing power supply.
